oneLiner: A shared log for capturing what was decided, why, and when—so teams stop relitigating the past.
problem: Teams make important decisions in scattered Slack threads, meetings, and docs, then forget the reasoning behind them. This leads to repeated debates, lost context when people leave or join, and no clear record of accountability or timing for key choices.
targetUser: Team leads, product managers, and founders at startups or fast-moving teams who need a lightweight system of record for decisions without the overhead of full project management tools.
coreFlow: User creates a new decision entry with a title and description
User records the context/reasoning and any alternatives considered
User tags stakeholders involved and sets the decision date
Entry is saved to a searchable, chronological log
Team members can browse, search, or filter past decisions by tag, date, or owner
Users can comment or add follow-up notes if a decision is revisited or reversed

screens.name: Decision Log Feed
screens.purpose: Chronological, searchable list of all logged decisions with filters by tag, owner, or date

screens.name: New Decision Entry
screens.purpose: Form to capture the decision, rationale, alternatives considered, and stakeholders

screens.name: Decision Detail View
screens.purpose: Full view of a single decision including history, comments, and any status updates (active, reversed, superseded)

screens.name: Search & Filters
screens.purpose: Advanced search across all decisions by keyword, tag, team, or timeframe

screens.name: Team Settings
screens.purpose: Manage team members, tags/categories, and permissions for who can log or edit decisions
